name: 0000_lethal_lady_bullseye.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE `backups` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE `realms` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL
)

name: 0001_nappy_mariko_yashida.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE `auth_attempts` (
	`key` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`window` integer NOT NULL,
	`attempts` integer NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE `game_accounts` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`username` text NOT NULL,
	`player_id` text NOT NULL,
	`legacy_site_id` text,
	`password_hash` text NOT NULL,
	`salt` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE `game_sessions` (
	`token_hash` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`account_id` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`account_id`) REFERENCES `game_accounts`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

name: 0002_realtime_lease.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE `realtime_leases` (
  `id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  `owner` text NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` integer NOT NULL
)

name: 0003_account_characters.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE game_characters (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
 account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 slot INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(slot BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 job TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(job IN ('swordsman','mage','archer')),
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(account_id,slot)
)
ALTER TABLE game_sessions ADD COLUMN selected_character_id TEXT REFERENCES game_characters(id)
